caption: The video captures a round metal pot filled with water sitting on a lit gas-stove burner, the water already in a steady, sustained boil. Bubbles churn and rise continuously across the surface, their pattern shifting from moment to moment while the overall activity level remains constant. A translucent steam layer hovers above the water, its density and shape fluctuating slightly as the boil proceeds. Beneath the pot, a blue flame stays present at the bottom edge, its visible shape shifting slightly as the camera drifts. To the right, a patterned tile counter holds a second metal vessel. A black stove control knob sits partly visible at the lower left edge. As the excerpt unfolds, the framing shifts subtly, nudging the pot within the frame and drawing the left knob partly out of the edge, while the right-side vessel stays largely in place. The water level and the pot's position appear essentially unchanged, the boiling continuing without pause.
